name: plotkit-static
description: Dev-only build for PlotKit front-end static scripts (esbuild transpile TS -> ESM JS; zero runtime deps).

scripts.build: esbuild src/plotkit/static/app.ts src/plotkit/static/render2d.ts src/plotkit/static/view3d.ts src/plotkit/static/nsview.ts src/plotkit/static/plot2d.utils.ts src/plotkit/static/plot3d.utils.ts src/plotkit/static/ui/state.ts src/plotkit/static/ui/layout.ts src/plotkit/static/ui/inspector.ts --format=esm --target=es2020 --outdir=src/plotkit/static --log-level=warning
